subject: general
question: What is the name of the zone where trade winds converge?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Inter-tropical convergence zone__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In the** northern hemisphere** the northeast trade winds from the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• The point at which the forces the trade winds convergently blow air up into the atmosphere, **forming the ITCZ.**
 
• The trade winds are winds that are east to west just** north and south of the equator.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/250d70ee82d537d43d4c0e6212201b195ce1f356c2daa8a54e4f52febcc81c64.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In **West Africa, the forest zone** refers to the southern part of the region once covered by** tropical rainforest.**
 
• **Solar radiation** is the term that is used to describe visibly.
 
• Nearly visible radiation is emitted by the** sun.**
